_doc: The unlocks of the starters_2 pack: one starter_ship for each of the 20 race starters (layout A opens by reaching the race's homeland, in its dock event; layout B by its homeland's quest, on the outcomes that win the tech). The design of each is in this pack's ships/, with its hangar field {group, layout, unlock}. Payload: {ship, group, layout}.
